title: Add IC custom domain asset files for shivaritaglobal.com

requirements.text: In `frontend/src`, add a `.well-known` directory (if it does not already exist) and create a file named `ic-domains` (no file extension) at `frontend/src/.well-known/ic-domains` with the exact content: `"shivaritaglobal.com"`.

quotes: I want to connect my custom domain. In order to do this in the front end src directory add .well-known/ic-domains which is a file with no extension. The content of the ic-domains file should be "shivaritaglobal.com"

acceptanceCriteria: The file has no extension and is named exactly `ic-domains`.
The file content is exactly `"shivaritaglobal.com"` (including the quotes).

requirements.text: In `frontend/src`, create a file named `ic-assets.json` with the exact contents: `[{"match":.well-known","ignore":false}]` (including brackets/quotes exactly as provided).

quotes: in the front end src directory create a file "ic-assets.json", the contents of that file is: '[{"match":.well-known","ignore":false}]"

acceptanceCriteria: The file content matches exactly the user-provided text: `[{"match":.well-known","ignore":false}]`.

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, or `frontend/src/components/ui` (immutable paths).
nonGoals: Do not implement DNS configuration or automated domain verification flows inside the app.
Do not add backend changes for domain management or storage.
